title: Treasury Admits Insolvency. Bitcoin Already Knew.
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

**The US Treasury just admitted it's insolvent — $47 trillion gap between assets and liabilities. Bitcoin already priced this in.**

That's not theory. That's accounting. Satoshi coded against monetary debasement that's already documented and signed by the people running the printing press.

**Signal one: MicroStrategy pulled over a billion dollars of Bitcoin off markets in a single trading session.** Post-halving miner issuance down fifty percent. Those coins aren't coming back.
